        (7, 4, 2, 8), (7, 5, 1, 8), (7, 6, 3, 8),
    ],
    # city inflow capacity
    "city_cap": {

        7: 13,
    },

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    cities = d["cities"]
    arcs = d["arcs"]
    net_supply = d["net_supply"]
    city_cap = d["city_cap"]

    cost = {(i, j): c for (i, j, c, u) in arcs}
    link_cap = {(i, j): u for (i, j, c, u) in arcs}

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.cities = pyo.Set(initialize=cities)
    model.arc_index = pyo.Set(
        initialize=[(i, j) for (i, j, c, u) in arcs], dimen=2
    )

    def x_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, link_cap[(i, j)])

    model.x = pyo.Var(
        model.arc_index,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=x_bounds,
    )

    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(cost[(i, j)] * m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.arc_index)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    def balance_rule(m, k):
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.arc_index if j == k)
        outflow = sum(m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.arc_index if i == k)
        return inflow - outflow == net_supply[k]

    model.flow_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.cities, rule=balance_rule)

    def city_cap_rule(m, k):
        return sum(m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.arc_index if j == k) <= city_cap[k]

    model.city_capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.cities, rule=city_cap_rule)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    cities = d["cities"]
    arcs = list(d["cost"].keys())

    model.C = pyo.Set(initialize=cities)
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=arcs, dimen=2)

    # x[i,j] = amount transported from city i to city j
    # assumption: variable_domain NonNegativeReals; link capacity as variable upper bounds
    def _x_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, d["link_cap"][(i, j)])

    model.x = pyo.Var(
        model.A,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=_x_bounds,
    )

    # Objective: minimize total transportation cost
    def _obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["cost"][(i, j)] * m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=_obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Flow balance: inflow - outflow = net_supply
    def _balance_rule(m, k):
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, k] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k)
        outflow = sum(m.x[k, j] for (i, j) in arcs if i == k)
        return inflow - outflow == d["net_supply"][k]

    model.flow_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.C, rule=_balance_rule)

    # Demand satisfaction: inflow >= demand for each demand city
    demand_cities = [k for k in cities if d["demand"][k] > 0]
    model.D = pyo.Set(initialize=demand_cities)

    def _demand_rule(m, k):
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, k] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k)
        return inflow >= d["demand"][k]

    model.demand_sat = pyo.Constraint(model.D, rule=_demand_rule)

    # City capacity: total inflow <= city capacity
    def _city_cap_rule(m, k):
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, k] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k)
        return inflow <= d["city_cap"][k]

    model.city_cap = pyo.Constraint(model.C, rule=_city_cap_rule)

    return model
